reuse.why: Changes only the existing shared getScheduledAmount, still using getApproxNumberThreshold for the tolerance.

duplication.why: No logic duplicated; the rule is simplified in its single definition.

placement.why: The planning rule stays in shared/schedules.ts where every planner (schedule templates, previews, balances, tables) reads it.

scope.why: Touches only the rule and its tests.

maintainability.why: The rule becomes simpler (min of the range, amount minus tolerance) with an updated comment.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All consumers keep going through getScheduledAmount.
